To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we present CheckInside, a fine-grained LBSN that uses a combination of Wi-Fi and Bluetooth signals to provide indoor localization with an accuracy of 2.5 m, which is 2.5-3x better than the state-of-the-art.

we present CheckInside, a fine-grained location-based social network that leverages Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) beacons to provide accurate location estimation indoors, and that we present an efficient algorithm to rank venues based on user preferences.

(i) indoor localization accuracy affects the quality of the ranked list, which in turn affects the quality of LBSNs' recommendations; (ii) indoor localization accuracy also affects the quality of venue coverage, which is a major factor in the success of LBSNs; and (iii) we propose CheckInside, an indoor location-based social networking system that leverages fine-grained indoor localization and a social network to improve the quality of recommendations and venue coverage.
